H2601.name: Hanamel
H2601.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2601.brief: Jeremiah's cousin, from whom he bought a field.
H2601.short: Hanamel, Jeremiah's cousin, sold a field to the prophet as a sign of future restoration during the Babylonian siege.

H2605I.name: Hanan
H2605I.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2605I.brief: One of David's mighty warriors, son of Maacah.
H2605I.short: Hanan, the son of Maacah, was one of King David's mighty warriors.

H2605G.name: Hanan
H2605G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2605G.short: Hanan, a Benjamite, was the son of Shashak, as mentioned in the genealogy of Benjamin in 1 Chronicles.

H2605H.name: Hanan
H2605H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2605H.brief: Son of Azel, a descendant of King Saul.
H2605H.short: Hanan, a descendant of King Saul, was the son of Azel, as mentioned in the genealogies of 1 Chronicles.

H2605J.name: Hanan
H2605J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2605J.brief: A temple servant who returned from Babylonian exile.
H2605J.short: Hanan was among the temple servants who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

H2605O.name: Hanan
H2605O.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2605O.brief: Son of Igdaliah, associated with the Rechabites.
H2605O.short: Hanan, the son of Igdaliah, was associated with the Rechabites and had a chamber in the temple during Jeremiah's time.

H2605L.name: Hanan
H2605L.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2605L.brief: A Levite who signed Nehemiah's covenant.
H2605L.short: Hanan, a Levite, was among those who signed the covenant led by Nehemiah to follow God's Law.

H2605M.name: Hanan
H2605M.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2605M.brief: Another Levite who signed Nehemiah's covenant.
H2605M.short: Hanan, a Levite, was among the signatories of the covenant led by Nehemiah to follow God's Law.

H2605N.name: Hanan
H2605N.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2605N.brief: A treasurer appointed by Nehemiah for the storehouses.
H2605N.short: Hanan, the son of Zaccur, was appointed by Nehemiah as one of the treasurers responsible for the storehouses.

H2605K.name: Hanan
H2605K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2605K.brief: A Levite who helped explain the Law to the people.
H2605K.short: Hanan, a Levite, assisted Ezra in teaching the Law to the people during the post-exilic period.

H2607H.name: Hanani
H2607H.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2607H.brief: A musician in the temple during David's reign.
H2607H.short: Hanani was a temple musician during King David's reign, assigned to the twenty-fifth division.

H2607G.name: Hanani
H2607G.desc: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2607G.brief: A seer who prophesied during the reign of Asa.
H2607G.short: Hanani, a seer, prophesied during the reigns of Asa and Jehoshaphat, kings of Judah.

H2607I.name: Hanani
H2607I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2607I.brief: A returnee from Babylon who had married a foreign wife.
H2607I.short: Hanani was among the returnees from Babylon who had married foreign wives during the time of Ezra.

H2607J.name: Hanani
H2607J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2607J.brief: Nehemiah's brother, who reported on Jerusalem's condition.
H2607J.short: Hanani, Nehemiah's brother, brought a report about the dire situation in Jerusalem, prompting Nehemiah to take action.

H2607K.name: Hanani
H2607K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2607K.brief: A priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.
H2607K.short: Hanani, a priest, was among those who participated in the dedication ceremony of the rebuilt wall of Jerusalem.

H2608P.name: Hananiah
H2608P.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2608P.brief: Son of Heman, a musician in David's time
H2608P.short: Hananiah, a son of Heman, appointed as a musician during King David's reign.

H2608L.name: Hananiah
H2608L.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2608L.brief: Son of Zerubbabel, a descendant of King David.
H2608L.short: Hananiah, a descendant of King David, was the son of Zerubbabel and had a son named Pelatiah.

H2608O.name: Hananiah
H2608O.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2608O.brief: Descendant of Benjamin mentioned in genealogy
H2608O.short: Hananiah, a descendant of Benjamin, is listed in the genealogy in <ref="1Ch.8.24">1Ch.8.24</ref>.

H2608Q.name: Hananiah
H2608Q.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2608Q.brief: Jeiel's son, an army secretary under King Uzziah
H2608Q.short: Hananiah, son of Jeiel, served as an army secretary during King Uzziah's reign.

H2608T.name: Hananiah
H2608T.desc: Daniel's compatriot living at the time of Exile and Return
H2608T.brief: One of Daniel's three friends in Babylon.
H2608T.short: Hananiah, also known as Shadrach, was one of Daniel's three friends who were thrown into the fiery furnace for refusing to worship Nebuchadnezzar's golden image.

H2608R.name: Hananiah
H2608R.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2608R.brief: One who married a foreign wife during Ezra's time
H2608R.short: Hananiah, an Israelite who married a foreign wife during Ezra's time.

H2608A.name: Hananiah
H2608A.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2608A.brief: A false prophet who opposed Jeremiah's prophecies.
H2608A.short: Hananiah, a false prophet, opposed Jeremiah's prophecies and falsely predicted the end of the Babylonian captivity within two years.

H2608M.name: Hananiah
H2608M.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2608M.brief: An official during the reign of King Jehoiakim.
H2608M.short: Hananiah, an official during King Jehoiakim's reign, was present when Baruch read Jeremiah's scroll in the royal secretary's chamber.

H2608N.name: Hananiah
H2608N.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2608N.brief: A gatekeeper during the time of Jeremiah.
H2608N.short: Hananiah, the son of Shelemiah, was a gatekeeper who arrested Jeremiah on suspicion of defecting to the Babylonians.

H2608I.name: Hananiah
H2608I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2608I.brief: A signatory of the covenant during Nehemiah's time.
H2608I.short: Hananiah was among the leaders who signed the covenant to follow God's law during Nehemiah's time.

H2608J.name: Hananiah
H2608J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2608J.brief: A priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim.
H2608J.short: Hananiah was a priest who served during the high priesthood of Joiakim, as recorded in <ref="Nehemiah 12:12">Nehemiah 12:12</ref>.

H2608K.name: Hananiah
H2608K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2608K.brief: A priest who played the trumpet during the wall dedication.
H2608K.short: Hananiah, a priest, played the trumpet during the dedication ceremony of the rebuilt wall of Jerusalem.

H2608G.name: Hananiah
H2608G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2608G.brief: Shelemiah's son, helped repair Jerusalem's wall
H2608G.short: Hananiah, son of Shelemiah, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time.

H2608S.name: Hananiah
H2608S.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2608S.brief: A perfumer who helped rebuild Jerusalem's wall
H2608S.short: Hananiah, a perfumer, participated in rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

H2608H.name: Hananiah
H2608H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2608H.brief: Appointed as a governor of Jerusalem by Nehemiah.
H2608H.short: Hananiah was appointed by Nehemiah as the governor of Jerusalem, along with Hanani, due to his faithfulness and fear of God.

H2619.name: Hasadiah
H2619.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2619.brief: A descendant of King Jeconiah (Jehoiachin) of Judah.
H2619.short: Hasadiah was a descendant of King Jeconiah (Jehoiachin) of Judah.

H2660H.name: Hepher
H2660H.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2660H.brief: A Mecherathite, one of David's mighty warriors.
H2660H.short: Hepher the Mecherathite was one of David's mighty warriors.

H2660G.name: Hepher
H2660G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2660G.brief: A son of Ashhur, from the tribe of Judah.
H2660G.short: Hepher was a son of Ashhur, a descendant of Judah.

H2660A.name: Hepher
H2660A.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2660A.brief: Son of Gilead, ancestor of the Hepherites.
H2660A.short: Hepher was a son of Gilead and ancestor of the Hepherite clan in the tribe of Manasseh.

H2657G.name: Hephzibah
H2657G.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2657G.brief: The mother of King Manasseh of Judah.
H2657G.short: Hephzibah was the mother of King Manasseh, who ruled over Judah.

H2618.name: Hesed
H2618.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H2618.short: Hesed was one of the twelve district overseers who provided supplies for King Solomon and his household.

H2695.name: Hezro
H2695.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H2695.short: Hezro the Carmelite was one of David's mighty men, known for his valor and military prowess.

H2696H.name: Hezron
H2696H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2696H.brief: Son of Perez, grandson of Judah, ancestor of David.
H2696H.short: Hezron was the son of Perez and grandson of Judah, and his descendants formed the Hezronite clan within the tribe of Judah.

H2696G.name: Hezron
H2696G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2696G.brief: Son of Reuben and grandson of Jacob.
H2696G.short: Hezron was a son of Reuben, the firstborn of Jacob, and his descendants formed a clan within the tribe of Reuben.

H2652.name: Hophni
H2652.desc: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
H2652.brief: A corrupt priest, son of Eli.
H2652.short: Hophni, along with his brother Phinehas, was a corrupt priest who served under his father Eli at the tabernacle in Shiloh.

H2621H.name: Hosah
H2621H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2621H.brief: A Levite gatekeeper during David's reign.
H2621H.short: Hosah was a Levite who served as a gatekeeper at the tabernacle during the reign of King David.

H2647.name: Huppah
H2647.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2647.short: Huppah was a priest who was assigned the thirteenth division of priestly service during King David's reign.

H2650G.name: Huppim
H2650G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2650G.short: Huppim is mentioned in the genealogy of Manasseh as a descendant of Ir or as a son of Machir.

H2650H.name: Huppim
H2650H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2650H.short: Huppim, also known as Hupham or Huram, was a descendant of Benjamin mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis, Numbers, and 1 Chronicles.

H2609.name: Hanes
H2609.brief: An Egyptian city mentioned in a prophecy against Judah.
H2609.short: Hanes was an Egyptian city to which Judah sent envoys, as mentioned in a prophecy by Isaiah (<ref="Isaiah 30:4">Isaiah 30:4</ref>).

H2615.name: Hannathon
H2615.brief: A border town in the territory of Zebulun.
H2615.short: Hannathon was a border town in the territory allotted to the tribe of Zebulun (<ref="Joshua 19:14">Joshua 19:14</ref>).

H2692.name: Hazar-addar
H2692.brief: A town on the southern border of Canaan.
H2692.short: Hazar-addar was a town on the southern border of Canaan, mentioned in the description of the land's boundaries.

H2693.name: Hazar-gaddah
H2693.brief: Town allotted to the tribe of Judah
H2693.short: Hazar-gaddah was a town in the Negev region, allotted to the tribe of Judah during the division of the Promised Land (<ref="Josh 15:27">Josh 15:27</ref>).

H2694.name: Hazer-hatticon
H2694.brief: Place on the ideal border of Israel
H2694.short: Hazer-hatticon, meaning "the middle village," was a place named on the ideal border of Israel in Ezekiel's vision (<ref="Ezk.47.16">Ezk.47.16</ref>), likely identical to Hazar-enan.

H2699.name: Hazerim
H2699.short: Hazerim, meaning "villages," refers to the settlements inhabited by the Avvim, a people group dispossessed by the Caphtorim (<ref="Deut 2:23">Deut 2:23</ref>).

H2698.name: Hazeroth
H2698.brief: Israelite encampment during the wilderness wanderings
H2698.short: Hazeroth was one of the places where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings, mentioned in the context of Moses' leadership challenges (<ref="Num.11.35; 12:16; 33:17-18; Deut 1:1">Num.11.35; 12:16; 33:17-18; Deut 1:1</ref>).

H2674K.name: Hazor
H2674K.brief: Region in Arabia, possibly Ituraea, threatened by Nebuchadnezzar
H2674K.short: Hazor refers to a region in Arabia, possibly Ituraea, against which Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, launched a military campaign (<ref="Jer.49.28,30,33">Jer.49.28,30,33</ref>).

H2674G.name: Hazor
H2674G.brief: Major Canaanite city conquered by Joshua
H2674G.short: Hazor was a major Canaanite city, whose king Jabin led a coalition against Israel; it was captured and destroyed by Joshua (<ref="Josh 11:1,10-11,13">Josh 11:1,10-11,13</ref>), later oppressing Israel before being defeated by Deborah and Barak (<ref="Judg 4:2">Judg 4:2,17</ref>).

H2674H.name: Hazor
H2674H.brief: A town in the southland of Judah.
H2674H.short: Hazor was a town allotted to the tribe of Judah in the Negev region.

H2674I.name: Hazor
H2674I.brief: Town in the Negev region of Judah
H2674I.short: Hazor was a town in the Negev region, part of the territory allotted to the tribe of Judah (<ref="Josh 15:23">Josh 15:23</ref>).

H2674J.name: Hazor
H2674J.brief: Town resettled by Benjamites after the Babylonian exile
H2674J.short: Hazor was a town resettled by the Benjamites after their return from the Babylonian exile (<ref="Neh.11.33">Neh.11.33</ref>).

H2675.name: Hazor-hadattah
H2675.brief: Town in the Negev region of Judah
H2675.short: Hazor-hadattah, meaning "New Hazor," was a town in the Negev region, part of the territory allotted to the tribe of Judah (<ref="Josh 15:25">Josh 15:25</ref>).

H2660B.name: Hepher
H2660B.brief: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua; later a Solomonic district.
H2660B.short: Hepher was a Canaanite city conquered by Joshua and later became part of a district under Solomon's rule.

H2621G.name: Hosah
H2621G.short: Hosah, a Levitical city on the border of Asher (<ref="Joshua 19:29">Joshua 19:29</ref>).

H2606.name: Tower of Hananel
H2606.brief: A tower in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah
H2606.short: The Tower of Hananel, a tower in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah and mentioned in prophetic visions of the city's restoration (<ref="Neh. 3:1; 12:39; Jer. 31:38; Zech. 14:10">Neh. 3:1; 12:39; Jer. 31:38; Zech. 14:10</ref>).
